description: minified wrapper for the context-6 LTO fx2-cmix no-dictionary package
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Uses the same cmix.bin.gz as fx2_struct_top_nodict_v1 but reduces counted wrapper bytes. Calls native no-dictionary mode: cmix -c input output and cmix -d input output.

1m_inherited_from_fx2_struct_top_nodict_.roundtrip_basis: same cmix.bin.gz and same native -c/-d arguments as the 1MB driver-verified parent

10m_inherited_from_fx2_struct_top_nodict.roundtrip_basis: same cmix.bin.gz and same native -c/-d arguments as the direct-verified parent

verdict: Promote as the smallest exact-S no-dictionary wrapper. It preserves archive bytes from fx2_struct_top_nodict_v1 and cuts counted wrapper bytes by 962.
